question: "Walking at (2)/(5) of his normal speed, Abhijeet is 18 minutes late in reach. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and destination is:
solution:
**Given:**

Walking speed = (2)/(5) of normal speed

Delay = 18 minutes

**Formula used:**

Let usual time taken = t minutes

When speed is reduced, time taken becomes (t + 18) minutes

**Calculation:**

⇒ t + 18 = (5/2) × t

⇒ 2(t + 18) = 5t

⇒ 2t + 36 = 5t

⇒ 36 = 5t - 2t

⇒ 36 = 3t

⇒ t = 12 minutes

**∴ The usual time taken by Abhijeet is 12 minutes.**
